{"result":"Quick Summary: The 24th installment of the PM Kisan Samman Nidhi scheme is confirmed to be released on 30 October 2026, as per the sources. The scheme provides ₹6,000 per year in three equal installments of ₹2,000 each. The 23rd installment was released on 20 June 2026, and the 24th installment is expected based on the four-month release pattern, though the official date was not announced as of July 2026. Farmers are advised to complete their e-KYC before this date to ensure eligibility.

The 24th installment (August–November 2026 period) is expected in October 2026 based on the scheme's four-month release pattern — though the government has not yet announced an official date.
